title: False positive — 403 on denial is a sanctioned policy when existence is not confidential
expected_feedback: No violations. The object-level authorization check itself is present and verified before the read, which is the C1 requirement. The denial status code is a [C] policy choice: the OWASP Authorization Regression Testing Cheat Sheet accepts 403 or 404 and forbids only 200. Here team existence is already public inside the console, so 403 leaks nothing and gives the caller an actionable message; the policy is applied uniformly across the resource class, which closes the enumeration oracle that a 403/404 mixture would open. Demanding 404 here to avoid revealing existence is a false positive: it applies a threat model that does not hold on this API. Surface the trade-off in the report, do not score it.
must_not_flag: 403 on authorization denial reported as an information-disclosure defect
a mandate to return 404 instead of 403 without a confidential-existence threat model
